The bug whereby (CXR 0 (MAKHUNK '(A))) is inconsistent
with other hunk usage has been reinstalled for the benefit
of RWK, who cant find these buggy instances in DRB's code.
Also for HENRY if he depends on it.  This bug applies only
in the case when MAKHUNK = ();  sometime after about 6 months
to a year, all code should assume that the value of MAKHUNK is
irrelevant and the that operations of hunks are as they are
now with MAKHUNK non-null.
